create_palette_from_color: create a player text palette mapping symbols to colors derived from a base RGBA color
build_color_scaled_tuple: build a scaled RGBA color tuple by multiplying RGB channels by a factor and clamping to 255
flip_ascii_sprite_horizontal: flip an ASCII art sprite string horizontally by reversing each line
flip_ascii_sprite_vertical: flip an ASCII art sprite string vertically by reversing line order
adjust_color_brightness_hsv: adjust color brightness by converting RGB to HSV, scaling the value channel, and converting back
